authorization: User authorized corrected-engine restart; retain predeclared sequential stopping schedule on fresh scenarios.
stop_rule: Stop new batches when the scheduled simultaneous exact interval excludes zero in either direction; otherwise continue to maximum. No futility stopping.
data_policy: All existing completed and in-flight confirmation executions retained. Analyze only complete prefixes of the original scenario sequence, after all batch jobs and repeats validate. No pilot pooling, outcome filtering, game termination or reruns.
prior_effect_access: No v21 inferential outcomes exist at registration; qualification games and all old outcomes are excluded.
false_positive_argument: Each existing exact interval has noncoverage at most its look alpha. Union bound over six looks is at most .04/53; over 53 hypotheses at most .04, under the original sampling assumptions. No independence between looks required.
remaining_checks: Fresh native qualification and AI-off control must pass before confirmation.
